title: Assuming RH: a map of theorems conditional on the Riemann Hypothesis
description:
An open dataset recording, for theorems proved assuming the Riemann Hypothesis or a generalization, exactly which hypothesis each proof uses, and whether the proof announced in November 2026 would make the result unconditional.

Entries are drafted by an AI system from the text of each paper and labeled with their review state. As of this version no entry has been checked by a person. Read the README before relying on any entry.
